CustomObject.description: Catalog of compliance risk/scope domains. Single source of truth for the dynamic domain selector on supplier intake (scVendorConsole) and for mapping each domain to its registry verification authority. Domain_Key__c must match the domain slugs used by the Python RAG corpus (quality, conflict, material, cyber, trade, finance, general). Add a record to introduce a new domain with no code change.
CustomObject.label: Compliance Domain
